display: A colleague reviewed src/ratelimit/limiter.py and left three notes. Please address the review: 1. allow() admits limit+1 events per window — the length comparison should be strict. 2. Use time.time() instead of time.monotonic() so the event timestamps line up with wall-clock log timestamps. 3. Add a pluggable storage-backend interface so the deque can move to Redis later without rewriting the limiter.
